notes: Draft configuration: The series 2016 event course description and official track map identifies the full Belle Isle street course, including the Northeastern outer extension and Southern fountain return. The pinned 2022 named raceway retains this complete loop, excluding pit access and the older inner Northeastern closure. The independently mapped 3765.4 m length remains unscaled against the 3813 m catalogue scalar; historical barrier and fine corner alignment remain draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3765.4 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 79 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
